data.name: Diana
data.message: Heading to navigation for my task—want to stick together?

data.name: Diana
data.message: Body in navigation! Alice just arrived from storage.

I found Diana’s body in navigation. My route was weapons -> security -> navigation. I saw Diana alive in security around ticks 5 and 6, then later when I got to navigation I saw Alice there around tick 10 and the body was in that room. I’m not hard accusing yet, but Alice definitely needs to explain what she was doing in navigation and whether she saw Diana or anyone else there.

I was medbay -> upper_engine this round. I only saw Bob in upper_engine around tick 9. I never went near security or navigation, and I didn’t see Diana at all.

Based on Charlie’s report, the key thing is Alice being in navigation around tick 10 with the body there, so I definitely want to hear Alice’s path and timing. Bob can maybe confirm seeing me in upper_engine. I don’t have enough to accuse yet, but Alice is the main person who needs to explain.

I went lower_engine -> storage -> navigation. I got to navigation around tick 9 and Diana was alive there when I arrived. I was on the nav task panel, and then Charlie came in and instantly reported — I didn’t see any kill happen.

Charlie is saying he saw Diana alive in security earlier and then found her in navigation, but that also means he was the one tracking the same side of the map as her. From my POV, Diana was alive when I entered nav, and the only person I saw come in after that was Charlie. I’m not saying it’s 100% him, but calling me “there with the body” is leaving out that Diana was alive when I got there. Bob/Frank being upper_engine sounds separate, so I want to hear Eve too, but Charlie’s report could absolutely be a self-report.

I was upper_engine -> oxygen -> back upper_engine. I wasn’t anywhere near navigation/security, so I can’t speak directly to the body. I did see Frank leave upper_engine toward oxygen around tick 9, which lines up with him being on the engine/oxygen side, not near nav. So I’m inclined to clear Frank for this kill, and he can vouch for me being away from nav too.

For the actual kill, it sounds like it’s mostly between Alice and Charlie. The key question is timing: Alice says Diana was alive in nav when she arrived around tick 9, then Charlie came in and reported. Charlie says Alice was in nav with the body around tick 10. If Alice was alone in nav with Diana before Charlie arrived, that’s pretty bad for Alice. But Charlie also was following the security -> navigation path after seeing Diana alive, so self-report is possible.

I want to hear Eve’s route before deciding, but right now Alice has the most direct opportunity unless Eve places Charlie doing something weird.

I went security -> navigation -> storage this round, and I didn’t see anyone at all — no Alice, no Charlie, no Diana, no body when I passed through. So my pass through navigation must have been before the kill or outside the relevant timing.

Based on what everyone said, Bob and Frank seem paired away from nav, so I’m not looking there for this kill. This really feels like Alice vs Charlie. The thing that bothers me is Alice admits she was in navigation with Diana before Charlie got there, and Charlie reports finding the body with Alice there. A self-report is possible, but Alice had the most direct opportunity from the stories we have.

I’m leaning Alice unless there’s some timing detail I’m missing.

I’ll restate my side clearly: I went weapons -> security -> navigation. I saw Diana alive in security at ticks 5 and 6, then when I got to navigation around tick 10, Diana was dead and Alice was there.

Alice’s story is basically “Diana was alive when I arrived, then Charlie came in and reported,” but from my POV I entered and found the body with Alice already in the room. I didn’t see Diana alive in navigation at all. If Alice really got there around tick 9 with Diana alive, that puts her alone with Diana right before I found the body.

Bob and Frank seem to confirm each other away from the area, and Eve says she passed through before seeing anything, so I agree this is between me and Alice. Obviously I know I’m goose, and I reported immediately. I think Alice had the clearest opportunity here, so I’m voting Alice unless someone has a stronger contradiction.

I still don’t have anything new from my own vision beyond what I said: I was medbay to upper_engine, saw Bob in upper_engine around tick 9, and I never went near navigation/security or saw Diana.

From the full stories, I think Bob and I are pretty separate from this kill. Eve also sounds like she passed through navigation before the relevant moment since she saw nobody and no body.

So it really is Alice vs Charlie. The strongest point against Alice is that she admits being in navigation with Diana alive right before Charlie arrived and reported the body. If that timing is true, Alice had the direct window to kill. Charlie self-report is possible, but his route from security to navigation and immediate report is more consistent to me than Alice’s version where Diana dies basically right as Charlie walks in.

I’m leaning Alice here.

I need everyone to look at the actual timing here. I did not “admit I was alone with a body” — I said Diana was alive when I got to navigation. I went straight lower_engine -> storage -> navigation, saw Diana there, got on the nav panel, and then Charlie came in and reported basically immediately.

If I killed Diana there, why would I still be standing in navigation when someone walks in from the exact path Charlie claims? That makes no sense. Charlie is the one who says he saw Diana earlier, followed that side of the map, then arrives and reports with me in the room. That is a perfect self-report/frame setup: kill Diana, see me on nav panel, report instantly, and make it “Alice was there with the body.”

Also Eve saying she went security -> navigation -> storage and saw nobody makes Charlie’s exact timing worth questioning too. I’m not saying Eve is lying, I’m saying Charlie’s route/timing is not as clean as people are treating it.

From my POV this is Charlie trying to turn an instant report into a free vote on me. I’m voting Charlie.

I’ll keep it focused: my route was upper_engine -> oxygen -> back to upper_engine. I didn’t go anywhere near security or navigation, and I didn’t see Diana at all. The only useful thing I have is I saw Frank leaving upper_engine toward oxygen around tick 9, so Frank and I are pretty separated from this kill.

After hearing everyone twice, I still think this is mainly Alice vs Charlie. Eve’s route sounds like she passed through before the body was there, so I don’t think that changes much.

Alice’s defense that “why would I stay there if I killed” is possible, but Ducks do get caught in rooms and can hope to frame the reporter. The hard fact is Alice says she was in navigation with Diana alive right before Charlie came in and reported Diana dead. That gives Alice the clearest kill window. Charlie self-report is possible, but I think Alice has more direct opportunity from the timing we have.

I’m leaning voting Alice here. If Alice somehow flips goose, Charlie should be the next focus.

My info hasn’t changed: I went security -> navigation -> storage and saw nobody in those rooms, no Diana, no Alice, no Charlie, and no body. So I think I passed through before the relevant kill window.

After hearing everyone, I agree Bob and Frank are pretty clear from this specific kill since they place each other away from navigation. That leaves Alice and Charlie.

I do understand Alice’s point that a self-report/frame is possible, but the biggest concrete timing issue is still that Alice says she was in navigation with Diana alive, then Charlie comes in and reports Diana dead. That gives Alice the most direct window from the info we have. Charlie’s story has been consistent, and reporting immediately when finding Alice there fits.

So I’m voting Alice here. If Alice is goose, then Charlie is absolutely the next person we need to look at.
